explanation: A blueprint is a task pattern, not an enqueued task or permission to work. Only an explicitly requested specimen queue process may instantiate task records.

blueprints.deliverable: Metro definition, official source for boundaries and constituent jurisdictions, dated geographic identifiers, supported study bounds.
Find official permissible API endpoints, policy/attribution, coverage, vintages, access and ID systems for each capability.
Source-to-place and source-to-dataset mappings, measure meanings, join rules, identifiers, units, dates, and unavailable-data notes.
Browser-source adapters constrained by study area, source policy, cache permission, pagination and safe rate limits.
Map controls, layer legends, opacity/highlights, missingness and temporal labels for required available capabilities.
Unit/browser QA, real-provider verification, public-text audit, source permissions and documentation of partial coverage.
